<!-- move awakenawakennomi:cellular_overload -->

### Cellular Overload { #awakening-cellular-overload }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/sara/axolotl/cellular_overload.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

Pushes the axolotl's cells past their limits, removing every bad effect that can be removed, and for a short time most of the health the user loses grows back in a few seconds. When it ends the user gets really hungry.

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

| Stat | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Cooldown | 60 s (1200 ticks) |

</div>


<!-- move awakenawakennomi:toxic_bloom -->

### Toxic Bloom { #awakening-toxic-bloom }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/sara/axolotl/toxic_bloom.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

Releases all the poison stored in Toxic Reserve at once, hurting and poisoning the enemies around. The more health was stored, the harder it hits.

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

| Stat | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Min cooldown | 15 s (300 ticks) |
| Max cooldown | 45 s (900 ticks) |
| Max damage | 150 HP |

</div>


<!-- move awakenawakennomi:toxic_reserve -->

### Toxic Reserve { #awakening-toxic-reserve }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/sara/axolotl/toxic_reserve.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Passive*

While in an awakened form all the health the axolotl regenerates is stored as poison in its body, Toxic Bloom can release it. The poison slowly goes away once the user stops fighting.
